# Medical requirements

You must complete an immigration medical examination before you come to Canada. This applies to all permanent residence applicants under Express Entry. A panel physician performs the exam and sends the results directly to IRCC. Do not send the results yourself. Your medical exam is valid for a limited period after which you may need to repeat it.

## On this page

- Overview
- Who needs an exam
- How to book

## How to book

Book your exam with a panel physician approved by IRCC. Bring valid identification and any prior medical records you have. The physician records the results electronically and transmits them securely.

# Express Entry overview

Express Entry is an application management system for skilled worker immigration to Canada. It covers three federal economic programs. Candidates create a profile and receive a score under the Comprehensive Ranking System. The highest ranked candidates receive an invitation to apply for permanent residence.

# Become a Canadian citizen

To become a Canadian citizen most applicants must already be permanent residents, have lived in Canada for a required period, file their taxes, pass a citizenship test, and take the oath of citizenship. This page is out of scope for an Express Entry permanent residence applicant and must be skipped at the URL scope stage.
